critique: The black background and clean mint-to-neon-green triangle sprites match the intended graphic language, and frame 4 now expands noticeably beyond frame 1. However, the result still reads as a heavily overlapping central burst rather than a clear, airy 2D triangle field: many individual triangles are obscured, and the overall spread remains modest relative to the frame. A wider directional dispersion with fewer concurrent particles is needed to make the motion-graphics triangle arrangement legible.

suggestions.why: Increase particle travel so the burst occupies substantially more of the composition and has energetic visible motion between frames.
Widen the directional spread so triangles fan into a 2D field instead of remaining concentrated in one overlapping central mass.
Reduce the number of simultaneously visible sprites, preserving distinct triangular silhouettes as the field expands.
